steps.clueRiddle:
Three hours east with a big river beside us.
Games, bingo and French words will guide us.
steps.clueReveal: We drive from Kingston to Montréal today. Play all three car games on the way. Learn your first French words before we arrive.

challenges.title: Montréal Trivia Deck
challenges.instructions: Answer questions about the city ahead. One big question at a time. Every answer comes with a fun fact.

challenges.title: St. Lawrence Bingo
challenges.instructions: Watch for each thing out the window. Tap a square when you spot it. Four in a row is bingo.

challenges.title: First French Words
challenges.instructions: Flip the cards and say each word out loud. Then match the French to the English. Three words will get you far today.

steps.funFact: The moment you cross into Québec, every road sign switches to French.

steps.clueRiddle:
A riverside park sits halfway there.
Count what floats by, or go searching — choose with care!
steps.clueReveal: Stop at Lamoureux Park on Water Street East. This is a Detour: pick Count or Search. You only have to do one.

a.label: Count
a.blurb: Stand still by the river and count. Calm, quiet and easy.

challenges.title: Riverfront Count
challenges.instructions: Count every boat on the St. Lawrence. Then count the gulls and the flags. Add up your grand total.

b.label: Search
b.blurb: Hunt along the riverfront path. Dry shoes, sharp eyes.

challenges.title: Riverfront Search
challenges.instructions: Walk the path beside the river. Find all five things on the list. Tap each one to check it off.

steps.funFact: The St. Lawrence River carries ships all the way from the ocean to Lake Superior.

steps.clueRiddle:
Climb the little mountain that named the city.
From up top, the whole view is pretty.
steps.clueReveal: Park at Beaver Lake and walk to the Kondiaronk Belvedere. It is a flat fifteen-minute path. Look out over the city and find five things.

challenges.title: Spot from the Top
challenges.instructions: Stand at the railing and look far out. Find all five things in the view. Point at each one before you tap.

steps.funFact: Montréal is named after Mount Royal, the small mountain right in the middle.

steps.clueRiddle:
Aisles and carts and a list in your hand.
Tonight's dinner is hiding — go find it fast!
steps.clueReveal: Go to the Provigo near the Bell Centre. Find six dinner ingredients on your list.

challenges.title: Supermarket Sweep
challenges.instructions: Find each grocery item on the list. Put it in the cart. Tap to check it off.

steps.funFact: In Québec, food packages must always show French words first.

steps.clueRiddle:
One little word opens every door in Québec.
Say it out loud to the person at the desk.
steps.clueReveal: Walk up to the hotel front desk. Say bonjour to the person working there. Smile — that is the whole challenge.

challenges.title: Say Bonjour
challenges.instructions: Read the phrase card out loud first. Then say it to the front desk person. Use a big, friendly voice.

steps.funFact: In Québec, people say bonjour when they arrive and bonsoir at night.

steps.clueRiddle:
Mackay Street is tonight's finish line.
Roll your bag to the mat — leg two is done.
steps.clueReveal: Check in at Hôtel Monroe on Rue Mackay. Find your suite and drop your bags. Then step onto the pit stop mat.
steps.funFact: Your suite has a kitchen, so tonight the team cooks dinner together.
